description: java.io.File, String and StringBuilder constructors produce the path or text value of their arguments, so a tainted name stays a path-traversal source through them.  A name cleaned by a path sanitizer stays clean through the File constructor.  A multipart part's submitted file name is a source.

expected.notes: inline header source in new File(..) reaches FileInputStream
upload destination built from the name
Files.copy reads from the user-chosen path
new String(bytes) is the same text
the sanitizer helper clears FILE_IO before the File constructor
the multipart part's file name reaches the upload destination
